name: @penguinharness/agent-evaluation
description: Agent Evaluation: design and calibrate a capability Benchmark for an agent (or import a published Benchmark package), and run and privately score its cases one isolated execution at a time — the measurements the Default RSI Toolkit's optimization loop runs on.

quick_start.prompt: List the Benchmark packages in Prism-Shadow/penguin-harness-benchmark and tell me in one line each what they measure. Import nothing until I pick one.
